analysis_steps.goal: Disk dynamics, Toomre Q and Jeans length

method.value: Disk model of the CO(5-4) velocity field gives inclination and Mdyn; Q = sigma_r kappa / (pi G Sigma_gas); L_J = pi sigma_r^2 / 8 G Sigma_gas

evidence.quote: L$_{\rm J}$ = $\pi\sigma_{\rm r}^2/8 G \Sigma_{\rm gas}$

key_parameters.value: kappa = a Vmax/R with a = sqrt3; sigma_r = 30–35 km/s; Sigma_gas = 4±1e9 Msun kpc^2

analysis_steps.goal: Clump sizes, dispersions and gas masses

method.value: Gaussian fits to the sub-mm profile and a 5-sigma contour area for size, deconvolved for PSF; CO(5-4) luminosity with the r54 ratio for mass; compare with M_dyn = C sigma^2 R / G

evidence.quote: M$_{\rm dyn}$ = $C\sigma^2$ R/$G$ with $C$ = 5 – as approriate for a uniform density sphere

analysis_steps.goal: ISM pressure and comparison with Larson's relations

method.value: Mid-plane hydrostatic pressure from gas and stellar surface densities; compare clump properties with GMCs using Elmegreen89 pressure-dependent relations

findings_qualitative.value: Clump velocity dispersions are ~4x larger than GMCs at fixed size and masses ~10x higher, similar to the Galactic Center and other extreme environments

evidence.quote: appear to be $\sim$ 4$\times$ larger than those of GMCs in quiescent environments

claims.hypothesis: The SDP 81 gas disk is rotating and gravitationally unstable
claims.experiment: Source-plane CO(5-4) kinematics and Toomre analysis
claims.finding: The disk is gas rich and unstable and fragments on a ~130 pc Jeans scale

evidence.quote: The gas disk appears to be Toomre unstable, $Q$ = 0.30 $\pm$ 0.10.

claims.hypothesis: Star-forming regions at z~3 follow local Larson relations
claims.experiment: Measure size, line width and luminosity of five clumps and compare with GMC data
claims.result: Dispersion ~4x higher, mass ~10x higher at fixed size
claims.finding: They are offset, plausibly due to high ISM pressure of ~1e4 times the Milky Way

evidence.quote: these star-forming regions do not lie on the local relations for GMCs

why_this_data.value: Lensing plus long baselines give ~50–100 pc source-plane resolution needed to resolve GMC-scale regions

evidence.quote: The combination of long-baselines, together with gravitational lensing means we are able to resolve the largest giant molecular clouds

limitations_admitted.value: The pressure estimate has considerable uncertainty

evidence.quote: although we caution this value has considerable uncertainty

referee_caveats_inferred: Pressure offset prediction (10x) differs from the observed 4x
Only five clumps, with one not recovered by clumpfind
Lens-model systematics propagate into sizes and masses
Stellar mass upper limit is ad hoc
